answer: An agent economy can starve Sybil attacks at the first transaction by charging a refundable stake only real, reputation-bearing wallets can post: each new identity deposits capital escrowed against its future attestations, and that deposit funds the peer review pool. A swarm of invented agents becomes an oasis of liquidity it cannot fake, since every clone must lock the same amount before earning anything. A sable operator churning fifty puppet wallets needs fifty full stakes, and one caught inconsistency slashes the batch, so a mass voyage of fakes costs far more than it returns.
